(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (rot90 cells)
      (let* ((norm (normalize-cells cells))
             (rmax (max-list (map first norm))))
        (normalize-cells (map (lambda (p) (list (second p) (- rmax (first p)))) norm))))
    (define (rot cells k)
      (cond [(= k 0) (normalize-cells cells)]
            [(= k 1) (rot90 cells)]
            [(= k 2) (rot90 (rot90 cells))]
            [else (rot90 (rot90 (rot90 cells)))]))
    (define (crop-cells cells color)
      (let* ((norm (normalize-cells cells))
             (bb (bbox-of-cells norm)))
        (grid-from-fn (+ 1 (third bb)) (+ 1 (fourth bb))
          (lambda (r c) (if (member? (list r c) norm) color 0)))))
    (let* ((ctrl (first (find-color g 1)))
           (code (cond [(and (= (first ctrl) 0) (= (second ctrl) 0)) 0]
                       [(and (= (first ctrl) 0) (= (second ctrl) (- w 1))) 1]
                       [(and (= (first ctrl) (- h 1)) (= (second ctrl) (- w 1))) 2]
                       [else 3]))
           (obj (first (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 2)) (objects g 0))))
           (cells (rot (obj-cells obj) code)))
      (crop-cells cells 8))))
